title: Make F# semantic confidence reflect selected-context authority
outcome: F# symbol_at and definition report exact confidence only when the selected type-check context has no incompleteness or substitution cause; disclosed standard-SDK assumptions stay exact and all authority loss downgrades to indexed with reasons retained.
acceptance: A singular fsharp-semantic-confidence-authority capability, version bump, and agent/design documentation describe the rule.

Clean contexts and SDK implicit-authority assumptions report exact confidence while retaining partial disclosures; fallback, parse failure, truncation, diagnostics, limits, unavailable, and unresolved causes report indexed.
Focused tests, full quality gates, and the required dual-agent review pass.
The F# semantic confidence mapper classifies every existing partial cause into disclosed-modelling-assumption or incompleteness/substitution buckets.

completion.summary: Completed the shipped v0.12.80 F# semantic-confidence authority work represented by commit 4bbcc3b: exact is reserved for authority-preserving checked contexts, all errors and degraded causes report indexed, disclosures remain visible, and capability/docs/tests/gates/review are recorded.
